conflicts: Level energies: the LAC database values refer to 249Cf (centre of gravity as derived by Conway et al. assuming zero hyperfine width of the ground level), the Mainz laser values to 250Cf. Differences: 23 814.190 vs 23 814.468(2), 23 994.655 vs 23 994.450(2), 24 388.595 vs 24 388.809(2) cm^-1. They are mostly isotope shift (249-250: -6812, +6250, -5921 MHz = -0.227, +0.208, -0.198 cm^-1); the 249Cf energies are kept as energy_cm and the 250Cf ones are given as measured_energy_cm.

Hyperfine widths: Weber et al. 2023 show that the ground level of 249Cf has a total hyperfine splitting of 4.5 GHz (0.15 cm^-1), not zero as assumed by Conway et al.; the widths W printed in the LAC tables are therefore transition widths, and are not entered here.

Lifetimes of the three first excited states: the two runs of the 2022 paper (1830(20)/1710(25), 730(10)/675(10), 132(3)/126(3) ns) differ beyond their statistics (temperature-dependent conditions in the hot atomizer); the 2023 summary values 1770(70), 700(30), 129(5) ns are adopted.

Wavelength-table misprints: 540.8876 nm is printed with the odd level 18 482 (the level is 18 483.060); 353.1486 nm with 28 308 J=7 (two odd levels lie there: 28 308.005 J=3 and 28 308.595 J=7, the latter is used); for 1235.272 and 2086.998 nm the J printed in the wavelength table differs from the level table (level-table J used). Lines classified 'I' with half-integer J (1337.689, 1477.249 nm) belong to Cf II and were dropped; 1933.696 nm needs an even level 22 609 (J=10) that is not in the table.
527.9028 nm appears twice in the wavelength table with two classifications (19 303 J=8 - 38 240 J=8 and 11 074 J=6 - 30 012 J=7); both fit the level differences and both are entered.
Magnetic moment of 249Cf: -0.395(17) mu_N (2023, laser + atomic theory) against the older -0.28(6) mu_N (EPR on Cf3+, 1975, quoted in the same paper).
not_found: transition probabilities / oscillator strengths / branching fractions of Cf I lines: none located; only three level lifetimes (23 814, 23 994, 24 388 cm^-1) are measured
lifetimes of the first excited states of schemes D, E, F (26 408, 27 294, 27 779 cm^-1): not measured in Weber et al. 2022

hyperfine constants of other 249Cf levels: the LAC database prints only widths (and those assume a zero-width ground level)

notes: energy_cm values are 249Cf energies from the archived Laboratoire Aime Cotton database (compilation); three-decimal values +-0.010 cm^-1, two-decimal +-0.05 cm^-1. Isotope shifts are nu(A) - nu(250). Negative shift for lighter isotope in the 420 and 410 nm lines (5f -> 6d jump), positive in the 417 nm line (7s -> 7p). relative_intensity is 9 for every line of the source table (strongest lines only; 'R' = self-reversed), so it carries no ranking. Even levels above 30 000 cm^-1 are included because the strongest red / infrared Cf I lines end on them. The M1 line at 9078.145 cm^-1 is inside the ground configuration.
